verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no Fivetran sandbox or test environment that is isolated from production data. The closest items are adjacent, not the capability itself: the MCP server's read-only default scope is a permission control, not sandbox isolation. Copying connections to a new destination is a user-side workaround. The Connector SDK agent plugins mention building and testing connectors but do not describe an isolated sandbox.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
